resources.string: Guard
Guard locks your bike and turns on its motion watch. YABA stays connected and notifies you on this phone as soon as it detects movement.
Arm guard
Siren right away
At the first movement YABA detects, it turns on the bike’s siren. Without this setting YABA only notifies you; the bike then sounds its siren itself only after several shakes.
Connect YABA to the bike first.
Guard can only be armed while the bike stands still and no button is pressed.
The bike is updating its firmware or entering shipping mode. Guard cannot be armed now.
The bike is transferring data. Guard can be armed once the transfer is done.
Arming …
YABA locks the bike and waits until it confirms its motion watch. This takes up to %1$d seconds.
Guard on since %1$s
The bike watches for movement itself, and YABA stays connected.
The bike did not confirm its motion watch (alarm state %1$d). So YABA only detects a turning wheel, pressed buttons, the lock and the battery.
The bike did not confirm its motion watch. So YABA only detects a turning wheel, pressed buttons, the lock and the battery.
Try again
End guard
Siren off
Sliding ends the guard and unlocks the bike.
Without a connection, YABA waits up to %1$d seconds for the bike after you slide. If the connection comes back, the bike is unlocked; otherwise the guard ends in YABA only.
Alarm at %1$s
Restoring the guard …
Ending the guard …
YABA waits up to %1$d seconds for the connection to the bike.
Connection to the bike interrupted. The bike’s motion watch keeps running, and YABA reconnects.
Connection to the bike interrupted. YABA reconnects.
Latest
All events under Diagnostics
Share guard log
Notifications are off for YABA. The siren works, but your phone will not tell you about movement.
Allow notifications
Exclude YABA from battery optimization so Android does not end the connection to the bike overnight.
Open battery settings
While the guard is on, the alarm stays on.
While the guard is on, YABA stays connected to the bike. End the guard first.
Dismiss
Android did not start the guard service. The guard stays off.
The guard could not be armed. Reason: %1$s
The guard could not be armed.
The bike raised its own alarm while arming. YABA stopped the alarm, and the bike stays locked. Keep it still and try again.
The bike did not turn on its alarm (alarm mode %1$s). The guard stays off.
The bike did not lock (lock reports %1$s). The guard stays off.
The guard has ended, but the bike still reports alarm state %1$s. You can stop the alarm under “Alarm”.
The guard has ended. YABA could not reach the bike, so nothing changed on the bike.
The guard has ended because the bike is no longer saved in YABA.

The guard could not be armed. Reason: %1$s. The bike may still be locked already or have its alarm on. Check the lever and “Alarm”.
The guard has ended and the alarm is off, but the bike still reports itself locked (lock %1$s). You can unlock it with the lever.
The guard has ended. YABA sent commands to the bike but got no answer. “Ride” shows the bike’s state after the next connection.
The bike is not locked (lock reports %1$s). “Try again” locks it and restores the guard.
YABA has no confirmation that the bike is locked. “Try again” locks it and restores the guard.
